mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by CYP2D6 and can competitively inhibit each other's metabolism; mexiletine may increase tolterodine levels while tolterodine may increase mexiletine levels, increasing risk of anticholinergic and cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects and cardiac arrhythmias; consider dose reduction of tolterodine if used concurrently; monitor ECG and mexiletine serum levels.
